articles.title: One of Street Fighter 2's Original Designers Wants to Rebalance Super Turbo 3 Decades After Its Release
articles.summary: Akira Nishitani, one of the original designers for Street Fighter 2 and Final Fight, expressed an interest in rebalancing Super Street Fighter 2: Turbo — over 30 years after its release.
body: In September 2026 — 32 years after Super Turbo hit arcades in 1994 — Akira Nishitani, a legend in the fighting game world and a veteran of the industry, shared a post on X/Twitter with the wild concept of rebalancing the game after so many years.

“Is it okay to tweak [Super Street Fighter 2 Turbo] again?” he wrote, as spotted and translated by EventHubs. “I wasn't really involved much, but if it's possible, I'd kinda like to give it a shot. Sorry if it turns into a nerf fest, lol.”

While Capcom has re-released a slew of its older fighting games over the years for various retro collections, we can’t imagine we’d get a totally rebalanced version of the original SSF2T, one of the most iconic titles in the Street Fighter 2 series. That being said, Nishitani himself believes that it deserves a second pass, though some members of the fighting game community aren’t so sure they agree with him.

For instance, James Chen, a longtime fighting game commentator and fighting game community (FGC) historian, believes such changes wouldn’t be well-received by players, given how beloved the title is and how fondly it's remembered.
points: Akira Nishitani, one of the original designers for Street Fighter 2 and Final Fight, expressed an interest in rebalancing Super Street Fighter 2: Turbo — over 30 years after its release.

articles.title: Trump Administration Tetris Clone Vanishes from White House Website Days After Launch
articles.summary: The Trump Administration appears to have pulled its 'Build the Wall' Tetris clone offline less than one week after its launch. The title launched last week alongside a small collection of other games as part of yet another attempt from The White House to connect with U.S. gamers.
body: Those who did try Build the Wall suggested it was clearly aimed to offend, not entertain. Aside from the criticism it received for its subject matter, which asked players to "protect the border from the incoming horde," players quickly realized the game itself didn't seem to be winnable at all. Instead of clearing filled lines, blocks would only continue to fall into place until reaching an inevitable ‘game over’ message when the screen was filled.

We don't know why the Tetris clone has disappeared, but we do know what followed after the Trump Administration launched Arcade.Gov. The website, which was marketed on social media with references to other gaming companies like Nintendo and Sega, quickly resulted in backlash online. The noise grew so loud so quickly that it didn't take long for The Tetris Company to respond.

"At Tetris, we believe in the power of connection and bringing people together, not dividing them," it said. "To our fans everywhere: we love you, we see you, and we're grateful to have you in our community."

articles.title: Xbox Game Pass Adds A Great Call Of Duty Game Today
articles.summary: Xbox Game Pass grows today with the addition of a popular Call of Duty game. New to the service from today, September 8, is 2020's Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War. It's available on Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, and PC Game Pass, and the game supports cloud streaming as well.
body: Developed by Treyarch and Raven, Black Ops Cold War is set in Cold War-era 1981, with its campaign following Russell Adler as he and his team seek out a spy named Perseus. The game also has multiplayer, of course, along with Zombies.
Black Ops Cold War was a bit hit, becoming 2020's best-selling game overall in the US.
Game Pass isn't done adding more titles this month, as The Royal Writ and Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O World Stage arrive on September 10, followed by RuneScape: Dragonwilds on September 15.

After Microsoft bought Activision Blizzard, many assumed that back-catalog Call of Duty games would flood Game Pass, but that didn't happen. Instead of releasing Call of Duty games en masse to Game Pass, Microsoft has taken more of a selective approach. Black Ops Cold War is now just the sixth Call of Duty game on Game Pass, joining Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty: Vanguard, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, and Black Ops 6.

articles.title: Call of Duty Adds Doom Slayer Skin as Part of New Halloween Update
articles.summary: Call of Duty's upcoming Halloween event will add the Doom Slayer to the game as a playable operator. As part of what is expected to be the final season of content for Call of Duty: Black Ops 7, Activision is adding in one of the most iconic protagonists in FPS history: the Doom Slayer.
body: The legendary FPS icon will be added on September 24 via an event pass, which players can purchase. There will also be a free tier which will include various items, such as Doom-inspired skins like a UAC scientist and reseracher, weapon charms, and more. The premium tier will have the Doom Slayer operator skin and the more sought after weapon blueprints.

The Haunting update will include a variety of other non-Doom content, including a nighttime version of the Avalon map, spooky content and foes in Black Ops 7's Endgame mode, limited-time multiplayer modes, and new maps. It's one last hoorah for Black Ops 7 ahead of Modern Warfare 4's release in October, so be sure to hop in and check it out while it lasts.

articles.title: Xbox’s Disc-To-Digital Program Has A Big Problem: Several Major Publishers Aren’t Participating
articles.summary: Xbox's disc-to-digital program looks like it could be a vital step forward for players who want to hold on to their physical games in an increasingly digital world, but it does have limits.
body: So far, it looks like games from Sega, Square Enix, Ubisoft, and Bandai Namco are largely incompatible with the disc-to-digital service. As verified by Kotaku, popping in a disc for a game from one of those publishers could result in a "not participating in digital licensing" message. A fan effort to catalogue all the games that do work with it also shows which titles from those publishers are incompatible with disc-to-digital, so if you were holding on to a physical edition of Far Cry 4, Final Fantasy 15, or Dark Souls 3, you're out of luck.

This is something that Square Enix has been called to task over, as several of its big HD-2D RPGs have no upgrade path to Switch 2. For example, if you purchased Octopath Traveler for the Switch, there's no complimentary or premium upgrade pack to give it sharper graphics and new features on a Switch 2 console. Instead, you'll have to buy the game again when its Switch 2 version launches, and you don't even get an option to transfer your save game over.
points: Xbox's disc-to-digital program looks like it could be a vital step forward for players who want to hold on to their physical games in an increasingly digital world, but it does have limits.

articles.title: 20 best board wipes in Magic: The Gathering
articles.summary: While early sweepers simply destroyed everything in sight, decades of card design have led to a fascinating variety of board wipe functionality. Modern alternatives often bypass indestructible keywords and death triggers using non-targeting exile effects or mass toughness penalties like -X/-X.
body: In Magic: The Gathering, board wipes (otherwise known as "sweepers") serve as the ultimate reset button. Whether you’re in a pinch with no creatures while your opponents have full armies, or you’re looking to slow the game down by ridding everyone of lands, these are the types of spells designed to clear multiple cards from the battlefield in a single shot. These kinds of big plays have been a pillar of Magic strategy since the game’s debut in 1993, when Alpha introduced Wrath of God and set the standard for mass destruction. Control and midrange decks rely heavily on these cards to erase an opponent's early momentum, using one card from your hand to level an entire battlefield of threats.

Whether you’re looking to survive a high-stakes 1v1 format or turn the tides in a chaotic four-player Commander pod, having the right sweeper in your deck is crucial. Presented in no particular order, here are 20 of the absolute best board wipes in MTG history, each bringing its own unique brand of devastation to the battlefield.

articles.title: GameStop Sets A New Financial Record, And It’s No Thanks To Games
articles.summary: Retailer GameStop has released its latest earnings report, and it was a record-breaker for the company. The Texas-based retailer's biggest number for its fiscal Q2 quarter that ended August 1 was $160.2 million.
body: Net income was up, too, reaching $298.7 million, compared to $168.6 million last year.

GameStop benefitted from continued growth in its biggest sales category--collectibles--which saw net sales jump a whopping 57% year-over-year to $356.3 million. For this latest period, collectibles made up 45.1% of GameStop's net sales.

GameStop was once primarily known as a video game retailer, and while it still sells games, consoles, and accessories, the company's biggest revenue-driver today is collectibles. Anyone who has walked into a GameStop store recently can attest to how much shelf space is dedicated to collectibles.

GameStop's next-largest revenue-driver was its "video game" category, which reached $263.2 million for the period, down sharply from $494.6 million during the same period last year that benefitted from the Switch 2 launch. Finally, GameStop's pre-owned and refurbished business made up $170.7 million during the period, down from $250 million last year.

articles.title: South Park Creators Reveal Official New Name for South Park
articles.summary: South Park 's creators are officially renaming South Park after three decades — but how long that name will stick remains to be seen. On Tuesday, show creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone revealed the new name of South Park in the duo's latest attack on U.S.
body: “Inspired by the bravery and patriotism of Apple and Google, we are changing the name of South Park to SOUTH AMERICA. We especially want to thank our parent company Paramount — a Skydance Capitulation,” Parker and Stone said in an official announcement.

The South Park creators are poking fun at Trump's executive orders that renamed the Gulf of Mexico to the Gulf of America and Lake Ontario to Lake America. Tech companies like Apple and Google quickly reacted to those orders, updating the names of each body of water on Apple Maps and Google Maps, respectively. Trump has also posted about renaming the state of New Mexico to New America, which he has no legal authority to do, but which Silicon Valley sycophants would embrace with great cowardice to curry favor with the current president.
Trump has been a big target for South Park in recent years. In Seasons 27 and 28 of the animated comedy, Trump is shown having sex with (and impregnating) Satan. Trump's flaccid penis is also shown.

articles.title: M. Night Shyamalan's 2027 Thriller Looks Like a Return to Form in First Trailer
articles.summary: M. Night Shyamalan has never exactly stopped making movies, but his recent work has existed in the shadow of the films that made him one of Hollywood's most recognizable filmmakers.
body: The director followed The Sixth Sense, Unbreakable, and Signs with a string of increasingly divisive projects, and even his more recent thrillers have struggled to reach the same cultural heights. Old was an intriguing but uneven high-concept thriller, Knock at the Cabin earned a stronger critical response but remained relatively modest at the box office, and 2024's Trap was another deliberately strange Shyamalan experiment that split audiences.

Now, though, there's something new brewing for early next year that looks like it could bring Shyamalan back to some very familiar territory: supernatural mysteries, romance, and eerie small-town secrets.

That movie is Remain, a rather unusual collaboration between Shyamalan and prolific romance novelist Nicholas Sparks, the author behind The Notebook. With the first teaser trailer now here, the movie is beginning to look like a particularly intriguing return to the kind of supernatural storytelling that made Shyamalan a household name.

articles.title: Less than a week after launch, The Blood of Dawnwalker developer is already getting to work on the sequel
articles.summary: With more than one million copies sold just a few days after its release, a "very positive" rating on Steama, and an enviable 83% review score from PC Gamer, vampiric horror RPG The Blood of Dawnwalker is a hit.
body: Unsurprisingly, "what comes next" is more Dawnwalker: Jakub Szamałek, narrative director at developer Rebel Wolves, wrote on LinkedIn (via Dexerto ) that "we're not resting on our laurels," but are already thinking about where to take the game from here.

"I'm looking for a lead writer to help me and the narrative team craft the next chapter in the Dawnwalker saga," Szamałek wrote. "We're looking for someone who, to put it bluntly, writes EXCEPTIONALLY well, has a track record of excellence and experience in team management."

The job listing provides more detail about what's involved and it's heavy stuff, with responsibilities ranging from writing in-game documents and dialog to collaborating with the narrative director—that's Szamałek—and other team leads, and managing the entire writers team. You'll also need "a minimum of six years of experience as a writer/narrative designer in the video game industry with a track record of outstanding achievement."

articles.title: Inspired by the success of games like Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, French president Emmanuel Macron declares 'videogames are part of our culture' and announces a new international gaming festival
articles.summary: One of the biggest videogames of 2025 was Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, a French JRPG that sold millions of copies, won armloads of awards, and earned not just one but two separate shout-outs from French President Emmanuel Macron.
body: Macron made the announcement during an address at the Lumiere Summit (via GamesRadar ), a conference where governments, businesses, creators, and "cultural institutions" can collaborate on the future of "cinema and the moving image." I assume that last bit is a just-missed translation of "motion picture," because that's clearly what the conference is about, but regardless, Macron used the moment to reveal his ambitions for a related-but-different effort.

"I firmly believe that videogames are part of our culture," Macron said (Google translated), adding that games should be considered part of France's cultural heritage, just as movies and "other creative endeavors" already are.

"Therefore, we will create an international videogame festival conceived from the outset as a major global event for creativity, innovation, gamers, and the industry. The great global successes of French videogames remind us of the richness of this creative endeavor, this creativity, which is also an industry. We must further celebrate it and strive to gain everyone's support."

body: The game has been created with a modern new aesthetic, one that appears to be striking the balance between the iconic original and modern tools at Nintendo's disposal. The result is a game that looks familiar but different, with highly details landscapes and faces. Link, especially, has an interesting look to him.
It's worth noting up front that there's a lot of positively surrounding the reveal. Multiple fans of the original have taken to social media to express their delight.

Nintendo's remakes look like what the original artists wanted to make, but couldn't because of the limitations of the era. Personally, I like it. It feels like playing with the promo art from strategy guides and magazine spreads. But it also means these new remakes look anachronistic in 2026.
However, these positive sentiments are matched by many detractors, some of whom making a connection between this new reveal and the Unreal Engine Nintendo joke mock-ups from the past.
